schema_stable.current_truth: Mandatory 23 fields for state tracking, including head_commit, branch, capabilities and latest_reports.
schema_stable.active_pack: pack_id, rollback_plan, stop_conditions, tests_required and optionally commands_required.
schema_stable.roadmap: roadmap_name, version, head_commit, last_updated, metrics_baseline, and packs array with status, preconditions, objective.
schema_stable.evidence: command, exit_code, stdout_log_path, stderr_log_path, started_at, finished_at, duration_seconds, cwd, python_executable, git_head, result, and run_by_runner.

scope_exclusion: Automatic git tagging on closeout (deferred to avoid credential/environment desyncs)
Real-time token cost enforcement during guard commands (relies on L2 ContextBudgetManager)
version_0_5_triggers: Adding support for multi-branch concurrent pack developments
Integration with external centralized dashboard APIs
